## What changed
Operating income moved from $37.7B to $46.1B — +22.3% ($8.4B) from 2025-Q2 to 2026-Q2.

## Why
- **Revenue** (61% of the move, $23.6B): Revenue +18.2% ($23.6B)
- **COGS** (31% of the move, $11.9B): COGS +18.5% ($11.9B)
- **R&D** (6% of the move, $2.2B): R&D +18.3% ($2.2B)

## What's driving it

## Context from previous runs
- Search Ads normally grows +12% ± 2pp (5 periods)
- Cloud normally grows +26% ± 12pp (5 periods)
- Cloud growth has exceeded 20% for 3 consecutive periods
- Devices & Network moved 2.6σ outside its trailing band

## Watch-outs
- CapEx +87.8% to $15.4B; free cash flow $34.8B (-2.8%) despite the operating move
- Revenue moved 5.5σ outside its trailing band — verify durability before annualizing
- COGS moved 6.8σ outside its trailing band — verify durability before annualizing
- R&D moved 2.9σ outside its trailing band — verify durability before annualizing
